contracts.description: totalPaidCents is a non-negative integer count of CAD cents in order version 1.
contracts.evidence: The producer returns totalPaidCents; storage serializes it; payment/refund/fulfillment compare the same persisted field. test/behavior.test.mjs supplies independent numerical and mismatch checks.

contracts.description: A captured receipt retains the order ID, CAD currency and exact totalPaidCents as amountCents.
